title: Vegan Tagine with Lamb Substitute
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew inspired by North African cuisine, using a lamb substitute for a meat-free option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Syrian, Jarring, and Malty. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the Lamb (substitute) and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the Tagine spice blend and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
